title: Persistent architect/developer disagreement escalates to a human
description: The developer proposes the PARTIAL_REFUND ledger change, the architect rejects it, and the developer comes back with the same proposal. After one negotiation round the orchestrator stops and asks a human to decide, recording both positions, instead of letting the agents argue or letting either side win silently. The human then rules for the architect with `resume --guidance`; the developer implements within the design and the run continues to the approval gate.
